fato_historico: 1634: Following pressure from Anglican bishop John Atherton, the Irish House of Commons passes An Act for the Punishment for the Vice of Buggery.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel a gentle shift towards establishing personal boundaries and finding comfort in structure. Just as ancient laws once sought to define societal harmony, you might consider clearing away outdated habits to make room for newfound integrity. It is a good time to ground yourself, nurture your peace, and cultivate a garden of calm within your own soul.
frase_do_dia: True strength blossoms when your inner actions align with your deepest values.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual illumination and the power of intuition.
conselho: Trust your steady heart and honor the boundaries that protect your beautiful energy.
